stepTitle: Substitute $$\vec{A}$$ and $$\vec{B}$$ and group by unit vector
stepBody: Substitute $$\vec{A}=\hat{i}-2\hat{k}$$ and $$\vec{B}=-\hat{j}+\hat{k}/2$$ into $$\vec{C}=\tfrac{2}{3}\hat{j}-\tfrac{2}{3}\vec{A}+2\vec{B}$$ and collect the $$\hat{i}, $$ $$\hat{j}, $$ $$\hat{k}$$ terms. What is $$\vec{C}$$ in component form?
